python3 - << 'PY'
# Monthly judiciary outlays (in millions of dollars) from FFO-3 tables
# Jan 1984 - Dec 1984 from treasury_bulletin_1985_03_page_22.txt
# Jan 1985 - Dec 1985 from treasury_bulletin_1986_03_page_26.txt  
# Jan 1986 - Dec 1986 from treasury_bulletin_1987_03_page_24.txt
# Jan 1987 - Mar 1987 from treasury_bulletin_1988_03_page_36.txt

monthly = [
    # 1984
    84,   # Jan 1984
    89,   # Feb 1984
    63,   # Mar 1984
    74,   # Apr 1984
    62,   # May 1984
    93,   # Jun 1984
    65,   # Jul 1984
    79,   # Aug 1984
    69,   # Sep 1984
    79,   # Oct 1984
    67,   # Nov 1984
    96,   # Dec 1984
    # 1985
    66,   # Jan 1985
    60,   # Feb 1985
    59,   # Mar 1985
    119,  # Apr 1985
    75,   # May 1985
    63,   # Jun 1985
    74,   # Jul 1985
    103,  # Aug 1985
    66,   # Sep 1985
    98,   # Oct 1985
    74,   # Nov 1985
    102,  # Dec 1985
    # 1986
    76,   # Jan 1986
    109,  # Feb 1986
    74,   # Mar 1986
    129,  # Apr 1986
    75,   # May 1986
    71,   # Jun 1986
    70,   # Jul 1986
    106,  # Aug 1986
    87,   # Sep 1986
    73,   # Oct 1986
    73,   # Nov 1986
    113,  # Dec 1986
    # 1987
    79,   # Jan 1987
    76,   # Feb 1987
    110,  # Mar 1987
]

print(f"Number of months: {len(monthly)}")
print(f"Months: Jan 1984 to Mar 1987 = 39 months")

# Verify: Jan 1984 - Dec 1984 = 12 months, 1985 = 12, 1986 = 12, Jan-Mar 1987 = 3
# Total = 12 + 12 + 12 + 3 = 39
assert len(monthly) == 39, f"Expected 39 months, got {len(monthly)}"

# Geometric mean = (product of all values)^(1/n)
import math
product = 1.0
for v in monthly:
    product *= v

print(f"Product: {product:.6e}")
n = len(monthly)
geom_mean = product ** (1.0 / n)
print(f"Geometric mean (raw): {geom_mean}")
print(f"Geometric mean (rounded to nearest thousandth): {round(geom_mean, 3)}")
